description: Consultation from Neighbouring Authority: London Borough of Barnet; Comprehensive, phased mixed-use redevelopment of the site comprising of 523 residential units (Use Class C3), 244 co-living units (Sui Generis) in five new buildings ranging from 8 to 26 storeys. A range of town centre uses; flexible commercial uses (Class E) and change of use of the Grade II listed Railway Hotel to a drinking establishment with expanded food provision (Sui Generis) with ancillary entertainment and cultural venue on the upper floor following the building's restoration. New public realm and landscaping, private and communal amenity space, associated car parking, cycle parking, refuse storage, servicing arrangements and access.
